item.title: uProVid v21.37.4
item.description:
Stand-in until the first uProVid factory release ships: ASJTube 1.2.1 by asjrx on YouTube 21.37.4 (ready-to-sideload build served by mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA), with YouPip, YTABConfig, YouQuality, YouChooseQuality, YouGetCaptions, YTHoldForSpeed, YTNativeShare, YTweaks, VolumeBoostYT, Return YouTube Dislikes, DontEatMyContent, PleaseDontStopTheMusic and Gonerino. Once this repository publishes a tweak-build/uprovid/* release, this listing serves your own build instead.
Build yours: python3 scripts/tweak_factory.py build
